en: Fixed installing a plugin with `claude plugin install` or `/plugin` putting it into an installed plugin's cache or data folder when their ids differ only in `.`, `-`, `@` or (macOS, Windows) capitals; the install is now refused
zh: 修复当 id 仅在 `.`、`-`、`@` 或（macOS、Windows）大小写上不同时，使用 `claude plugin install` 或 `/plugin` 安装 plugin 会将其放入已安装 plugin 的缓存或数据文件夹的问题；现在会拒绝该安装
